title: Scalable Evaluation of Medical AI using Evidence-based Practice Recommendations
abstract: arXiv:2611.27007v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rigorously evaluating medical artificial intelligence (AI) requires testing open-ended clinical management across diverse presentations and stages of care. However, existing benchmarks rely on manual expert authoring, limiting coverage across conditions, conditional care pathways, and evolving guidelines. We develop an automated pipeline that extracts and verifies structured clinical criteria and branching decision trees from practice recommendations to generate scenarios spanning the care continuum, including nuanced presentations and practice variations across regions and guideline editions. Applied to 436 BMJ Best Practice clinical monographs (354 US, 82 International), this yields 3,200 scenarios spanning differential diagnosis, investigations, treatment, and complications, plus targeted suites for regional specificity (731 US/International pairs) and temporal freshness (630 scenarios). translated_title: 基于循证实践推荐的可扩展医学人工智能评估
translated_abstract: 严格评估医学人工智能（AI）需要在多样化的临床表现和不同护理阶段中测试开放式的临床管理能力。然而，现有的基准测试依赖人工专家编写，限制了对各类疾病、条件性护理路径以及不断更新的指南的覆盖范围。我们开发了一个自动化流程，能够从实践推荐中提取并验证结构化临床标准和分支决策树，从而生成覆盖整个护理连续体的场景，包括细微的临床表现以及跨地区和不同指南版本的临床实践差异。将该流程应用于436份BMJ Best Practice临床专著（354份美国版，82份国际版），生成了3,200个场景，涵盖鉴别诊断、检查、治疗和并发症，此外还生成了针对地区特异性（731对美国/国际配对）和时间新鲜度（630个场景）的专项测试集。为了对回复进行评分，我们开发了一个临床医生校准的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个自动化流程，从BMJ Best Practice等循证临床实践推荐中提取并验证结构化临床标准与决策树，大规模生成3,200个涵盖鉴别诊断、检查、治疗与并发症的临床场景，实现了对医学AI在跨地区、跨指南版本条件下开放式临床管理能力的可扩展评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an automated pipeline that extracts and verifies structured clinical criteria and branching decision trees from evidence-based practice recommendations (e.g., BMJ Best Practice), generating 3,200 clinical scenarios spanning diagnosis, investigations, treatment, and complications to enable scalable evaluation of medical AI across regions and guideline editions.
